description:
This process starts with a department outlining its objectives for the upcoming period, such as hiring, equipment needs, or marketing efforts.
The team drafts a plan that includes cost estimates and justifications for the budget requested.
The plan is first reviewed in a strategic alignment meeting to ensure it aligns with broader organizational goals.
Following this, the finance department performs a detailed review to assess the budget's feasibility.
The plan may undergo several rounds of review and possible adjustments based on feedback from these reviews.
Each adjustment is documented and approved by necessary stakeholders.
Once the final version of the budget is approved, the budget is officially allocated to the department.
The process ends when the budget is distributed, and the department begins implementing its plan.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_BudgetAllocation" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/budget-allocation">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_BudgetAllocation" name="Departmental Budget Allocation" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_BudgetPlanningPeriod" name="Budget planning period begins">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToObjectives</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OutlineObjectives" name="Outline department objectives for upcoming period">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToObjectives</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ObjectivesToDraft</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DraftPlan" name="Draft plan with cost estimates and budget justifications">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ObjectivesToDraft</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DraftToStrategic</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StrategicAlignment" name="Review plan in strategic alignment meeting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DraftToStrategic</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StrategicToFinance</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinanceReview" name="Perform detailed finance review of budget feasibility">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StrategicToFinance</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NextReviewRound</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FinanceToFeedback</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GiveFeedback" name="Give review feedback on plan">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FinanceToFeedback</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackToDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdjustmentsNeeded" name="Adjustments needed?" default="Flow_NoAdjustment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeedbackToDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoAdjustment</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Adjust</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AdjustPlan" name="Adjust plan based on review feedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Adjust</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdjustToDocument</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DocumentAdjustment" name="Document adjustment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdjustToDocument</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DocumentToApproval</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApproveAdjustment" name="Obtain stakeholder approval of adjustment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DocumentToApproval</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NextReviewRound</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApproveFinal" name="Approve final version of budget">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoAdjustment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ApproveToAllocate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AllocateBudget" name="Allocate budget to department">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ApproveToAllocate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AllocateToDistribute</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DistributeBudget" name="Distribute budget to department">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AllocateToDistribute</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DistributeToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PlanImplementation" name="Department begins implementing plan">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DistributeToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToObjectives" sourceRef="Start_BudgetPlanningPeriod" targetRef="Task_OutlineObjectives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ObjectivesToDraft" sourceRef="Task_OutlineObjectives" targetRef="Task_DraftPlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DraftToStrategic" sourceRef="Task_DraftPlan" targetRef="Task_StrategicAlignment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StrategicToFinance" sourceRef="Task_StrategicAlignment" targetRef="Task_FinanceReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinanceToFeedback" sourceRef="Task_FinanceReview" targetRef="Task_GiveFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackToDecision" sourceRef="Task_GiveFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_AdjustmentsNeeded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdjustment" name="No adjustments" sourceRef="Gateway_AdjustmentsNeeded" targetRef="Task_ApproveFinal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Adjust" name="Adjustments required" sourceRef="Gateway_AdjustmentsNeeded" targetRef="Task_AdjustPlan">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${adjustmentsRequired}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdjustToDocument" sourceRef="Task_AdjustPlan" targetRef="Task_DocumentAdjustment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentToApproval" sourceRef="Task_DocumentAdjustment" targetRef="Task_ApproveAdjustment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NextReviewRound" name="Next review round" sourceRef="Task_ApproveAdjustment" targetRef="Task_FinanceReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApproveToAllocate" sourceRef="Task_ApproveFinal" targetRef="Task_AllocateBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AllocateToDistribute" sourceRef="Task_AllocateBudget" targetRef="Task_DistributeBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DistributeToEnd" sourceRef="Task_DistributeBudget" targetRef="End_PlanImplementation"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
